project_mode.description: Whether Diffmogger should create a fresh target project or integrate automation into an existing project.

automation_must_never_do.description: Non-negotiable actions the automation must never take.

env_access_policy.description: Whether automation may directly open local .env files, or may only rely on project commands that load env values normally.

additional_context_files.description: Optional project context files or copied target-relative context paths such as PDFs, research notes, or design docs. Do not include secrets.

local_notifications_enabled.description: Whether notifier modes should also use native local desktop notifications.

write_worker_agents_allowed.description: Whether the main automation agent may optionally spawn bounded write-capable worker agents for large, well-planned changes with disjoint ownership.

max_write_worker_count.description: Maximum number of write-capable worker agents the main agent may spawn in one run. Values are capped at 10 by the scaffold.

write_worker_guidance.description: Project-specific guidance for optional write workers. Keep this generic, bounded, and focused on disjoint ownership and main-agent integration.
write_worker_guidance.default: Write workers are optional and should be used only for large, well-planned changes with disjoint file or module ownership. Prefer fewer workers when the change can be done clearly by the main agent.

multi_role_automations_allowed.description: Backward-compatible derived mirror of automation_role_profile. New intakes should set automation_role_profile; scaffold ignores this flag when a valid profile is present.

automation_role_profile.description: Canonical automation profile. Use single_lane for simpler or non-engineering continuous work; use planner_builder_hardener_integrator for larger software engineering work.

automation_checkpoint_commits.description: Whether the integrator may create local automation-authored checkpoint commits before applying queued role patches.

automation_run_mode.description: Whether recurring automation should continuously improve the project or halt after a bounded local ticket campaign.

ticket_run_file.description: Legacy target-relative Markdown ticket import path. Leave empty for dashboard-backed SQLite ticket campaigns.

ticket_run_seed_tickets.description: Optional ticket-campaign seed tickets used only when initializing the dashboard-backed SQLite ticket queue.

ticket_completion_notify.description: Whether ticket-campaign finalization should send a native local desktop notification or record a fallback outbox entry.

multi_role_allow_remotes.description: Whether dashboard-managed local-only multi-role or conveyor jobs may set MULTI_ROLE_ALLOW_REMOTES=1 when the repo has configured git remotes. This does not permit pushes, fetches, pulls, or remote configuration.

optional_mcp_servers.description: Optional project-scoped MCP servers to configure for role-scoped Codex automation. Missing or unauthenticated MCP servers remain advisory and must not block overnight runs.

meaningful_deliverable.default: A runnable, verified change that improves the product or developer workflow.

beyond_mvp.description: Legacy field name for the neutral long-run direction used by continuous-improvement scaffolds. Ticket campaigns may leave this empty.
beyond_mvp.default: Continue improving core value, demo quality, integrations, and automation reliability.
